name: verbatim-relay
description: Relay a test conversation to a chat agent byte for byte. The model never writes either direction.

tap_url.title: Tap URL
tap_url.description: The URL that receives each message: the verbatim-relay tap in front of the agent.

agent_url.title: Agent URL
agent_url.description: Optional. The agent's own URL. Model tool calls to it are denied, the same as calls to the tap.

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: json: a JSON body with one message field. openai: an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.

message_field.title: Message field
message_field.description: json adapter: the dot path of the message in the request body.

reply_field.title: Reply field
reply_field.description: json adapter: the dot path of the reply in the response body.

openai_model.title: Model name
openai_model.description: openai adapter: the model field of each request. Empty means no model field.

openai_stream.title: Ask for a stream
openai_stream.description: openai adapter: send "stream": true in each request, for an agent that streams only on request.

record.title: Relay record
record.description: The relay record (JSONL), relative to the working directory or absolute.

cli.title: verbatim-relay command
cli.description: The verbatim-relay command that starts and ends a test and prints the transcript. Give a full path if it is not on PATH.

start_on.title: Start in relay mode
start_on.description: Start each session with relay mode on.
